summary.one_liner: A personal learning repository for operating systems concepts, with C implementations of homework exercises from Three Easy Pieces and planned side projects.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-study project in which the author works through the homework section of Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces and implements OS concepts in C where possible. The author also names CS:APP (csapp.pdf) as a reference, though the link is broken in the text. Study notes are kept as brief markdown files written in Obsidian and uploaded to the repo; they list main lesson topics and point the reader to the books for depth. The author says extra projects reinforcing OS concepts will be added later. The README invites contributions and critical feedback.
use_cases: Working through Three Easy Pieces homework solutions
Finding C examples of OS exercises
Reading beginner OS study notes in markdown
Following a self-paced CS fundamentals curriculum
notable: Organized around the Three Easy Pieces textbook homework
Study notes written in Obsidian markdown
Explicitly learning-focused: notes name topics rather than fully explaining them
Open to contributions and feedback from the author's stated beginner perspective
caveats: README is brief and does not describe build or run steps
Content is in early stages; planned extra projects are not yet described
Notes intentionally omit detailed explanations and direct the reader to external books and search
